title: Lok and the Betrayer/Quotes
summary:
"I'm done fighting you. Do what you have to."
- Den Fears to Harrison Fears

"Your strongest has already been destroyed. Listen to the truth and despair - Dante Vale is no more."
- The Betrayer to Sophie Casterwill, the Casterwills and the Huntik Foundation

"Dante Vale barely delayed the crushing fate of all mankind; what a waste. What he did was worthless, meaningless."
- The Betrayer

"I'm glad Dante isn't here to see this. I'd hate it if he had to waste his time on someone like you."
- Lok Lambert to the Betrayer after he mocked Dante Vale's sacrifice

"He had a plan, I know it. Dante wouldn't have sacrificed himself if he didn't believe in us, if he didn't believe we could finish this without him. He stopped the Red Comet to save us, get it? We're the plan! The Casterwills are the plan, the Huntik Foundation is the plan. [...] Everyone, we can fight, we can win!"
- Lok Lambert to the Huntik Foundation and Casterwills

"I've lost my husband. I won't lose my son too."
- Sandra Lambert to Scarlet Byrne

"Found a new chew toy, I see."
- Montehue to Fenris

"Harrison, I've looking after you until now because I really care about you..." (Zhalia Moon) 

"Don't go! You're a sister to me!" (Harrison Fears) 

"...But, I had to lie to you. I'm a spy and a member of the Huntik Foundation." (Zhalia Moon)

"She wasn't a Spiral, but other than you she was really my only friend. She was always there for me, I never thought twice about. What is wrong with me?" 
- Harrison Fears to Den Fears on Zhalia Moon

"Brother, please, I need your help to save my friend Zhalia."
- Harrison Fears to Den Fears

"Sorry, ugly. First you deal with us." (Den Fears)

"...Together." (Harrison Fears)

- the brothers to The Betrayer as they unite against him
